capabilities: display last-modified timestamps beside file names in the native file explorer
choose between MM-DD HH:mm and YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm time formats
refresh timestamps automatically when files are modified, created, renamed, or moved
hide timestamps when the sidebar is too narrow
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.4.0 or later; mobile compatibility not yet fully verified. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Works entirely offline with no network requests.
intentEvidence: This plugin enhances Obsidian's existing file explorer through DOM decoration.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer does not show when files were last modified, making it hard to spot recently edited notes and attachments.
summary: Adds last-modified timestamps next to each file name in Obsidian's native file explorer.
